title: Evals
description: config/evals.yaml: eval pass settings (PRD 6.6 'Lean evals', 19.2; EFF-06, EFF-07). A full pass runs every case once and deploy-gate cases three times, and stops at its credit cap with partial results. What the PRD states as a rule is const (three repeats, the 20% cost-regression threshold); the credit caps are config. Rules MT-09 to MT-11 in contracts/metering.rules.md. The eval case file shape stays in evals/case.schema.json, because only the harness reads it.

deploy_gate_repeats.description: Runs of each deploy-gate case in a pass (PRD 6.6, 19.2: three times); every other case runs once.

cost_regression_threshold.description: A cost per task or per role more than this share above the baseline fails the nightly job (EFF-06: 20%). Minimum and maximum repeat the const so generated Python checks it too.

credit_cap.description: Credits one pass may spend before it stops and reports partial results (PRD 6.6, EFF-07): a full pass, the nightly smoke pass and the deploy-gate pass (gate cases three times each). Values are the BQ-43 placeholders until the user sets them; they only bite on live passes, since dev and CI replay recordings (EFF-01).

groups.description: Expected case count for each of the eight PRD 19.2 groups. The PRD rows sum to 160 although its heading says 170 cases; the rows are the default (BQ-67). The harness checks the case set in evals/cases/<group>/ against it (MT-10). Exactly these eight groups.
